name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist from Ceres' distance is between the Botanist and Rios.
Cho goes with at most one of Pilot, Beacon, Callisto, and 6 ly.
The colonist in the Drift module's distance is immediately next to the Pilot.
Okafor's distance is exactly 2 ly more than the Botanist.
Earth goes with exactly one of Bauer, Okafor, or Rios.
Okafor's distance is at least 2 ly more than the colonist from Earth.
The colonist in the Cortex module's distance is exactly 2 ly more than the colonist from Ceres.
Ganymede goes with neither Bauer nor Drift.
The Engineer's distance is between Cho and the colonist from Callisto.
